DLJ-01.remark: Top drive motor failure. Rig down 8 hrs for repair.
DLJ-01.mitigation: Replaced top drive motor unit. Operations resumed.

DLJ-01.remark: Partial mud losses (3 m³/hr) at 950 m. Porous Tipam sandstone zone.
DLJ-01.mitigation: LCM pill pumped (30 ppb fine mica + 10 ppb graphite). Losses reduced to <0.5 m³/hr. Continued drilling.

DLJ-01.remark: Erratic torque 8–18 kN·m at coal stringer at 1,420 m. Possible BHA vibration.
DLJ-01.mitigation: Reduced WOB and RPM. Reamed 3 stands. Torque stabilised at 12 kN·m.

DLJ-01.remark: 0.8 m³ gas influx detected. Pit gain 0.8 m³. SIDPP = 280 psi. SICP = 320 psi. Barail sandstone overpressure.
DLJ-01.mitigation: Well shut-in BOP. Bullheaded with kill mud (MW 1.44 SG). Barrit method used. Kill successful in 6 hrs.

DLJ-01.remark: Pipe stuck (key seating) while pulling out. 15 m overpull.
DLJ-01.mitigation: Worked pipe. Spotted surfactant pill. Freed after 4 hrs. No fish left.

DLJ-01.remark: Seepage losses (1.2 m³/hr) in fractured Kopili zone. No cavings.
DLJ-01.mitigation: Increased mud viscosity. Pumped LCM sweep. Losses controlled.

DLJ-02.remark: Partial losses 4 m³/hr at 1,100 m. High porosity Tipam sandstone.
DLJ-02.mitigation: LCM treatment with medium nut plug + fine mica. Losses reduced to seepage.

DLJ-02.remark: Severe losses 18 m³/hr at 1,380 m. Total lost circulation. Pumps off.
DLJ-02.mitigation: Cement plug set at loss zone. Sidetracked. LCM mix (coarse+medium) pumped. Second cement plug. Losses controlled after 36 hrs.

DLJ-02.remark: Torque peaks at coal stringers 2,180–2,240 m.
DLJ-02.mitigation: Reaming pass. Optimised mud weight. Normal drilling resumed.

DLJ-02.remark: MWD tool failure. Fishing attempted. Tool retrieved after 22 hrs.

DLJ-03.remark: Torque spikes at Girujan-Tipam transition (820–870 m). BHA vibration.
DLJ-03.mitigation: Reduced RPM to 90. Added 10 m³ lubricant. Spikes eliminated.

DLJ-03.remark: Drill bit wear above threshold. Pulled for bit change.
DLJ-03.mitigation: New PDC bit run. Achieved 12 m/hr ROP on resume.

DLJ-04.remark: Partial losses (5 m³/hr) in Tipam. Highly permeable zone.
DLJ-04.mitigation: LCM pill with fine+medium mica. Losses controlled in 6 hrs.

DLJ-04.remark: Seepage losses in fractured Barail sandstone. 2.5 m³/hr.
DLJ-04.mitigation: Upped LCM concentration in mud system. Losses subsided.

DLJ-04.remark: Pipe stuck in Barail shale interbed at 3,120 m. Torsional sticking. 45 kN overpull. 28 hrs NPT.
DLJ-04.mitigation: Spotted large-volume oil pill (15 m³). Jar down. Pipe freed. BHA inspection done. Reamed to bottom.

DLJ-04.remark: Small gas influx 0.4 m³. SIDPP=180 psi. Kopili overpressure gradient.
DLJ-04.mitigation: Shut-in. Weighted kill mud 1.46 SG pumped. Driller's method. 4 hrs.

DLJ-05.remark: Losses at 1,200 m. Permeable Tipam. 3.5 m³/hr.
DLJ-05.mitigation: Nut plug + graphite LCM. Normal drilling resumed in 8 hrs.

DLJ-05.remark: Gas kick at 2,890 m Barail sandstone. Pit gain 1.2 m³. SIDPP=310 psi. SICP=365 psi.
DLJ-05.mitigation: Immediate shut-in. BOP closed. Well killed with 1.42 SG mud using driller's method. 6 hrs shut-in.

DLJ-05.remark: Shaker screen failure. Replaced on surface. 4 hrs NPT.

NKT-01.remark: Partial losses 6 m³/hr in Tipam sandstone.
NKT-01.mitigation: LCM sweep with walnut shell + mica. Losses controlled.

NKT-01.remark: Severe losses (22 m³/hr) in fractured Barail zone at 2,450 m. Total loss. Mud returns lost.
NKT-01.mitigation: 85 m³ LCM (coarse+fine) pumped. Cement squeeze at loss zone. Losses reduced to seepage after 48 hrs.

NKT-01.remark: Significant gas influx 1.8 m³ in Kopili Shale. SIDPP=480 psi. Formation pressure gradient 1.48 SG equivalent.
NKT-01.mitigation: Well shut-in. Bullheading with 1.52 SG kill mud. Took 12 hrs. Additional casing string recommended.

NKT-01.remark: Gas influx in Sylhet Limestone at 4,100 m. Pit gain 2.4 m³. SIDPP=680 psi. Fractured, overpressured reservoir.
NKT-01.mitigation: Emergency shut-in. Heavyweight kill mud (1.62 SG). 18 hrs kill operations. BOP tested post-kill. Extra casing string run.

NKT-02.mitigation: Fine LCM added to system. Self-healing after 2 hrs.

NKT-02.remark: Poor CBL across 2,050–2,150 m on 9⅝" casing. Gas migration risk. Micro-annulus suspected.
NKT-02.mitigation: Squeeze cementing performed. 4 m³ cement squeezed. Post-squeeze CBL shows improved bond.

NKT-02.remark: Intermittent torque spikes in Kopili. Possible balling.
NKT-02.mitigation: Increased flow rate. Reaming passes. Returned to normal.

NKT-03.remark: MWD/LWD tool failure at 2,450 m. Fishing required. 18 hrs NPT.
NKT-03.mitigation: Tool retrieved on fishing run. New MWD deployed. Operations resumed.

NKT-03.remark: Torque fluctuations in Kopili shale. Drag issues.
NKT-03.mitigation: Lubricant sweeps. Wiper trips performed. Problem resolved.

NKT-04.remark: Severe losses at 1,240 m. High permeability Tipam channel sand. 28 m³/hr.
NKT-04.mitigation: Lost circulation material mix. Cement plug set. Operations continued after 40 hrs.

NKT-04.remark: Total losses at 2,440 m fractured Barail zone. Cavernous loss zone confirmed by caliper.
NKT-04.mitigation: 85 m³ LCM pumped. Cement squeeze at 2,435–2,455 m. Drill water used during cure time.

NKT-04.remark: Total lost circulation at 3,420 m in fractured Barail sandstone. 85 m³ LCM material pumped over 3 days. Cavernous zone.
NKT-04.mitigation: Multiple cement plugs. Wellbore strengthening treatment. 72 hrs to regain circulation. Casing set above loss zone.

NKT-04.remark: Gas influx in Sylhet Limestone. Pit gain 1.5 m³.
NKT-04.mitigation: Shut-in BOP. Kill mud 1.58 SG. 8 hrs kill.

RDG-01.remark: Differential sticking in Barail shale at 2,980 m. 30 kN overpull. Pipe motionless for 2 hrs.
RDG-01.mitigation: Spotted 5 m³ oil pill. Applied slow rotation with top drive. Pipe freed after 14 hrs. Backreamed to surface.

RDG-02.remark: Torque spikes at 1,680 m in Tipam interbeds. BHA vibrations.
RDG-02.mitigation: Reduced WOB. Reaming pass. Problem resolved.

RDG-02.remark: Pump liner failure. Surface repair. 6 hrs NPT.
RDG-02.mitigation: Liner replaced. Operations resumed at full capacity.

RDG-03.remark: Total lost circulation at 1,240 m in cavernous Tipam zone. No returns. Confirmed lost returns on surface.
RDG-03.mitigation: Cement plug set. Sidetrack drilled. Second cement plug and LCM treatment. 60 hrs to restore partial returns.

RDG-03.remark: Partial losses (8 m³/hr) in Barail fracture zone.
RDG-03.mitigation: Bridging agent + graphite LCM pill. Losses reduced to 1 m³/hr. Continued drilling.

RDG-03.remark: Packoff while tripping in Kopili shale. 25 kN overpull.
RDG-03.mitigation: Worked pipe with circulation. 8 hrs to free.

HLG-01.remark: Gas shows in Barail sandstone. Pit gain 0.6 m³. SIDPP=180 psi.
HLG-01.mitigation: Mud weight increased to 1.38 SG. Well monitored. No full shut-in required.

HLG-01.remark: Erratic torque in Kopili shale. Clay balling suspected.
HLG-01.mitigation: PHPA/KCl mud pill swept. Reamed. Problem resolved.

HLG-02.remark: BHA change required after abnormal wear on stabiliser blade.
HLG-02.mitigation: Pulled to surface. New BHA run. 10 hrs NPT.

LKW-01.remark: Losses 5 m³/hr in Tipam porous zone.
LKW-01.mitigation: LCM treatment with medium mica + calcium carbonate. Continued.

LKW-01.remark: Fracture-induced losses 8 m³/hr in upper Barail.
LKW-01.mitigation: Bridging agent squeeze. Losses controlled to seepage.

LKW-01.remark: Pipe stuck in Kopili shale (differential sticking). High ECD. 45 kN overpull. BHA immobile.
LKW-01.mitigation: Initiated KCl/Polymer mud system change. Oil pill spotted. Slow rotation. Freed after 22 hrs. Wellbore stabilisation measures adopted.

LKW-01.remark: Second stuck pipe in Kopili interval (3,640 m). Shale swelling. 32 kN overpull.
LKW-01.mitigation: PHPA/KCl mud. Large-volume spotting. 18 hrs to free. Casing plan revised to include extra string.

LKW-02.remark: Losses 6 m³/hr in Barail fracture zone at 2,440 m.
LKW-02.mitigation: LCM treatment. Two-stage cementing planned for casing.

LKW-02.remark: Cement returns lost during 9⅝" casing cementing at 2,300–2,350 m. Micro-annulus suspected.
LKW-02.mitigation: Squeeze cement job performed. CBL post-job showed acceptable bond.

LKW-02.remark: Gas influx 0.7 m³ in Kopili. SIDPP=210 psi.
LKW-02.mitigation: Shut-in. Weighted mud (1.46 SG). 5 hrs kill.

MKM-01.remark: Torque spikes at coal stringers in Tipam.
Coal stringers in Barail causing intermittent torque spikes.
MKM-01.mitigation: Optimised drilling parameters. Completed drilling without issue.

DHJ-01.remark: Losses 7 m³/hr at 2,450 m Barail zone.
High torque (22 kN·m) in Kopili shale. Balling suspected.
Gas kick in Sylhet Limestone at 3,980 m. Pit gain 2.1 m³. SIDPP=720 psi. Highly overpressured fractured reservoir. Emergency BOP closure.
DHJ-01.mitigation: Emergency well control. 1.65 SG kill mud bullheaded. 12 hrs kill operations. All personnel accounted for. Well stabilised.

DML-01.remark: Fractured foothill sandstone with seepage losses 4 m³/hr.
DML-01.mitigation: Pumped 25 ppb fine mica LCM pill. Losses stabilized.

KHR-01.remark: Shallow high-pressure gas pocket in Kharsang thrust fault. Pit gain 1.1 m³.
KHR-01.mitigation: BOP shut-in. Killed with 1.38 SG mud.

KHR-01.remark: Partial loss in fault fracture zone.
KHR-01.mitigation: Medium nut plug LCM pill spotted.

KMC-01.remark: Overpressured Sylhet gas kick at 3,980 m. SIDPP=650 psi. Emergency well control.
KMC-01.mitigation: Bullheaded 1.50 SG kill mud. Re-established hydrostatic head in 14 hrs.

MNB-01.remark: Interbedded hard sands causing minor torque variation.

TZT-01.remark: Naga thrust belt complex. Dipping tectonic shale caused differential sticking. 40 kN overpull.
TZT-01.mitigation: Spotted surfactant oil pill and worked pipe. Freed after 16 hrs.

CHM-01.remark: Severe hole sloughing and pack-off in fractured Kopili shale. Total drillstring stall.
CHM-01.mitigation: High-density polymer sweep, backreamed out. Revised casing depth.

BAR-01.remark: Gas kick in overpressured Upper Bhuban sandstone. Pit gain 1.4 m³, SIDPP=420 psi.
BAR-01.mitigation: Well shut-in. Circulated out influx with 1.45 SG mud using Wait & Weight method.

ROK-01.remark: Partial mud loss 5.5 m³/hr in fractured Bokabil gas sand.
ROK-01.mitigation: Pumped 20 ppb coarse graphite LCM pill. Regained circulation.

AGT-01.remark: Intermittent string vibration and minor drag.
AGT-01.mitigation: Rotated and reamed stand. Parameters stabilized.

KLS-01.remark: Steep 45° tectonic dip and high horizontal stress caused severe borehole ovalization and mechanical pipe sticking.
KLS-01.mitigation: Heavy jar action and acid wash pill. Sidetracked interval with steerable motor.

BKH-01.remark: Major loss zone in tectonic fault breccia. Lost 16 m³/hr drilling fluid.
BKH-01.mitigation: Squeezed 15 m³ thixotropic cement plug. Re-drilled after 24 hrs curing.

JRB-01.remark: High-pressure gas influx in fractured fault zone. SIDPP=380 psi.
JRB-01.mitigation: Shut-in and weighted system up to 1.48 SG. Killed successfully in 8 hrs.

IMP-01.remark: Reacting swelling shales causing tight hole and high rotating torque.
IMP-01.mitigation: Inhibited mud with 7% KCl and PHPA. Wiper trip completed.

JNT-01.remark: Hard chert nodules in limestone bed causing bit chatter.

DHK-01.remark: Cavernous limestone loss zone (8 m³/hr loss rate).
DHK-01.mitigation: Spotted bentonite-diesel oil (BDO) gunk squeeze. Losses sealed.
